source_text: Λέγει ὁ Ναόδωρος τῷ Ὠριγένει· Ἡ ὁδὸς ἡμῶν οὐ κενὴ ἐγενήθη. Ὁ γὰρ ζητούμενος ηὑρέθη. Οὗτος ὑπὲρ τῶν Χριστιανῶν πάντων ἀπολογήσασθαι ἔχει. Καὶ προσαγαγόντων αὐτὸν τῷ ἡγεμόνι Ναόδωρος λέγει· Εὐμενείᾳ τῶν θεῶν καὶ προστάγματι τοῦ αὐτοκράτορος καὶ τῇ σῇ εὐτυχίᾳ, ἄρχον ἡμῶν ἐπίλεκτε, ηὑρέθη ὁ ζητούμενος φίλτατος τοῖς θεοῖς πᾶσιν πειθόμενος καὶ τοῖς νόμοις καὶ τῷ μεγάλῳ βασιλεῖ. Καὶ ὁ ἅγιος Κόνων μεγάλῃ τῇ φωνῇ ἔφη· Οὐχ ὡς ἔστιν λέγεις· ἐγὼ γὰρ πείθομαι τῷ μεγάλῳ βασιλεῖ Χριστῷ. Ὠριγένης λέγει· Ἐπίλεκτε τῶν ἡγεμόνων, πολλὰ περιοδεύσαντες κύκλῳ τὰ περὶ τὴν πόλιν οὐδένα εὑρεῖν δεδυνήμεθα εἰ μὴ τὸν γέροντα τοῦτον ἐν κήπῳ τινί.
thought_title: Conon is brought to the governor as obedient
orientation: Naodorus has Conon bound and dragged in, and now Naodorus and Origen present him before the governor.
pass_a_gloss: Naodorus says to Origen: Our road did not become empty. For the one being sought has been found. This man has to make a defense on behalf of all the Christians. And when they brought him to the governor Naodorus says: By the favor of the gods and by the command of the emperor and by your good fortune, our excellent ruler, the one being sought has been found, most dear, obeying all the gods and the laws and the great king. And holy Conon said with a loud voice: Not as it is are you speaking; for I obey the great King Christ. Origen says: Excellent one among governors, after going around much in a circle through the places around the city we have been able to find no one except this old man in a certain garden.

choices.why: legal sense of answering a charge on behalf of others, not apology

choices.english: by the favor of the gods
choices.why: dative of cause for Naodorus flattery formula, keeps gods plural
keeps ambiguous imperial title that Conon then redirects to Christ

choices.why: literal denial of truth of Naodorus presentation, preserves negation and force
rejected: What you say is not true

pass_b_english: Naodorus said to Origen, "Our journey has not come to nothing. The man we were looking for has been found. He will have to make a defense on behalf of all the Christians."

When they brought him before the governor, Naodorus said, "By the favor of the gods, by the command of the emperor, and by your good fortune, our excellent ruler, the man we sought has been found, a dear friend to the gods, obedient to all the gods and to the laws and to the great king." But Holy Conon cried out in a loud voice, "It is not as you say. I obey Christ, the great King."
Origen says, "Most excellent of governors, after ranging far and wide through the country around the city, we could find no one except this old man in a garden."
